verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents multi-step flows built from a trigger plus actions. It is positioned as a Zapier replacement with a 'flow builder' and an editor with a publish button, and it promises connecting 760+ apps 'without writing glue code'. The evidence never explicitly describes a visual or drag-and-drop canvas, and the no-code claim is limited to integration glue; actions can include 'running code'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual or drag-and-drop editor, evidence that ops users can build complete multi-step flows with no code at all, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the builder experience.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code

citations.quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated
Move data, send messages and update records between 763 apps without writing glue code.
Put a flow builder, AI agents and 760+ integrations inside your own product
To enable your changes, simply click on the publish button once you're done with your changes.
An open source replacement for Zapier
